description: The REPLICATION_PHRASES of filter/phrase_detection.py minus the reproduction-anchored subset: precise first-person, negation, qualifier and attempt framings of a replication claim. One clause per original pattern so a diagnostics run can attribute a hit. Routes to the cheap discard-only tier rather than admitting: a phrase without a cite is a claim about replication as often as it is a replication.

measured.sample: 2,892,614 real OpenAlex snapshot rows (10 manifest partitions of the stride-122 list, materialized locally) for the cost side, and the 7,505-paper override_positives.json gold corpus plus the 74-row goldneg_screen / 14-row goldneg_curated rejection pools for the recall side; branch analysis/stage-b-eval, analysis/stage_b_eval/vocab_holes_report.md, #144 evidence pass. Provenance caveat (#151): 4,681 of the 7,505 gold positives (62%) are `allrep_llm` — the old pipeline's own LLM verdicts, never human-confirmed — so the 186-of-319 recall figure is an upper bound; only the 38% curated share (entry_sheet 1,551, flora_db 1,266) is human evidence.
measured.rationale: #147 item 1, bundle T2 minus its GWAS-guard member (G1, which lives in phrase-with-cite's none_of): the five arms added here — the two-word gap between `we` and `replicate(d)` (C2), the sought/tried/wanted matrix-verb family (C1b), fail/unable/attempt to replicate (C12), the failure nouns (C6) and `attempted replication(s)` (C13) — recover 186 of the 319 gold positives that carry no matching phrase (58%), for 9.3 extra admissions per million scanned (+0.6%), 0 goldneg_screen hits and 7 goldneg_curated. The passive, gerund, `replicab*` and bare third-person arms are deliberately NOT here: T4 buys 65 more papers at 13x the admissions, and their noise (the biological-replicate and future-work senses) has no compact shape.
